about.description:
Brown, Driver and Briggs's Hebrew and English Lexicon of the Old Testament
(Oxford, 1906), with its appendix on Biblical Aramaic: every Hebrew and
Aramaic word of the Old Testament, its forms, meanings and related words
in other Semitic languages, with references to every verse where it is
used, in Sefaria's transcription, with corrections checked against the
1906 printing and the Westminster Leningrad Codex.

about.description:
Liddell and Scott's Intermediate Greek-English Lexicon (Oxford, 1889), the
"Middle Liddell": Greek words of the classical authors and the New
Testament, with their meanings, forms, and the authors who use them, in
the Perseus Digital Library's text as corrected by Benjamin Linskey, with
further corrections checked against the 1889 printing.

about.description:
James Strong's Concise Dictionary of the Words in the Greek Testament,
with their Renderings in the Authorized English Version (1890), in Ulrik
Sandborg-Petersen's edition: every Greek word of the New Testament by its
Strong's number, with its derivation, meaning, and renderings in the KJV.
